findings.title: Shard-split queries are interpolated twice
findings.body: runShardSplitQuery() now interpolates every target with applyTemplateVariables(), but splitQueriesByStreamShard() then passes those targets through runSplitQuery(), which after this PR also calls applyTemplateVariables() for every sub-request. The updated test codifies this by expecting 5 calls for 1 initial query and 4 shard sub-requests. Double replacement can corrupt queries whose interpolated variable value legitimately contains '$' or variable-like text, and can re-evaluate interval/range variables a second time instead of preserving the value fixed at the start. Interpolate once at the shard entry point for selector extraction and make the delegated runSplitQuery() call skip re-interpolation, or remove the early interpolation where it is not needed for sharding.

findings.title: Queries becoming empty after interpolation are no longer filtered
findings.body: The targets are filtered with query.expr before applyTemplateVariables() runs, so a query whose expression consists of a template variable that resolves to an empty string (for example expr='$variable' with an empty variable) survives the empty-query check and is then grouped, classified by isLogsQuery(''), and sent to runQuery()/Loki as an empty expression instead of being ignored like other empty queries. The same ordering was introduced in runShardSplitQuery(). Filter again after interpolation, or move the expr check after the map.
